title: Ox Passion Lychee Ice Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Lychee Ice is an exotic and refreshing fruit blend. It captures the distinctively sweet, floral, and juicy notes of tropical Lychee, perfectly balanced with a crisp, cooling ice finish. It delivers a smooth, aromatic, and deeply satisfying vape that stays fresh from the first puff to the last. The OX Passion Nic Salt range is crafted by OXVA, a brand renowned for their high-performance vape kits. These e-liquids are formulated to deliver intense, concentrated flavour, making them an excellent choice for vapers who prioritise taste. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to work flawlessly with low-wattage devices, particularly pod vape kits like the OXVA Xlim series, producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. OX Passion Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, allowing you to tailor your vaping experience. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
